full_judgment: 3. He further submits that rent receipts are document of possession and can be used as collateral evidence of title in the disputed land. The contentions of the learned Advocate are absolutely misconceived. The provisions as contained in Order 47 of the Code of Civil Procedure is more in the nature of enabling provision and it empowers the Court to review its judgment only under certain circumstances viz., on discovery of new and important matter on evidence, which after due diligence was not within the knowledge of the person aggrieved or could not be procured by him at the time when the decree was passed or the order was made. Secondly, where there is some apparent mistake or error on the face of the record and thirdly, on the ground of any other sufficient reason.
